anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all intervals, indicating potential performance bottlenecks or resource exhaustion.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, confidence, opportunities, or adjustments, which is unusual for a trading platform relying on AI for decision-making.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent potential slowdowns or system crashes.
Review and enhance AI strategy performance to ensure it is actively contributing to trading decisions.
Assess the effectiveness of current trading strategies and consider adjustments or new strategies to improve market engagement.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation of processes consuming high CPU resources and optimize or redistribute workloads.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.

recommendations.action: Evaluate AI system configuration and ensure it is correctly set up to perform learning cycles and generate trading opportunities.
